newsitem.title: USA: BEI Electronics to spin off sensors unit.
newsitem.headline: BEI Electronics to spin off sensors unit.

text.p: BEI Electronics said Wednesday it plans to form a new company called BEI Technologies Inc that will operate its established sensors and systems business.
BEI Electronics said it will distribute all the outstanding shares in the new company to holders of its common stock.

The company will discontinue its former defense systems business within the next year, and expects that financial reporting for BEI Technologies will reflect the defense systems segment as a discontinued operation.
BEI previously said it stopped making military rockets, once a major product line of the defense systems segment.
On a pro forma basis, BEI Technologies' continuing business had sales of $96.5 million in fiscal 1996.
BEI Electronics Inc will retain and operate its medical device business and plans to change its name to BEI Medical Systems Co after the spinoff.
The company expects the distribution to occur at the end of September. Afterwards, both companies would be immediately available for trading in the public market.
The company said the symbol BEIQ has been reserved for BEI Techonolgies in Nasdaq National Market.
The symbol BMED has been reserved for BEI Medical Systems.
